supporting_quotes.exact: Nine major versions of the architecture have been defined to date, denoted by the version numbers 1 to 9. Of these, the first three versions are now obsolete

observations.subject: ARM architecture
observations.object: nine, denoted by version numbers 1 to 9

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,105) 'Nine major versions of the architecture have been defined to date, denoted by the version numbers 1 to 9.' 直接陈述已定义 9 个主要版本（编号 1-9）；引文 [106,157) 'Of these, the first three versions are now obsolete' 直接陈述前三个版本已废弃。两个要素与 claim 逐项对应，无冲突证据。

supporting_quotes.exact: Is the 64-bit Execution state, meaning addresses are held in 64-bit registers, and instructions in the base instruction set can use 64-bit registers for their processing. AArch64 state supports the A64 instruction set

observations.subject: AArch64
observations.object: 64-bit Execution state supporting the A64 instruction set

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,170) 陈述 AArch64 是 64-bit Execution state，地址存于 64 位寄存器，且基础指令集指令可用 64 位寄存器处理；引文 [171,217) 'AArch64 state supports the A64 instruction set' 陈述支持 A64 指令集。claim 的三个要素（64 位执行状态、64 位寄存器、A64 指令集）均被同一引文直接覆盖，无冲突。

supporting_quotes.exact:
The architecture defines four Exception levels: EL0, EL1, EL2, and EL3. 
      
     
    
   
    
     R 
     VPSDB 
     
     
      
      EL3 is the highest Exception level and EL0 the lowest

observations.subject: ARM architecture
observations.object: four: EL0, EL1, EL2, and EL3

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,71) 'The architecture defines four Exception levels: EL0, EL1, EL2, and EL3.' 陈述四个异常级别；中间 [71,145) 为页面残留空白与字符 'R'/'VPSDB'，与 claim 无关且不构成冲突；引文 [145,198) 'EL3 is the highest Exception level and EL0 the lowest' 陈述 EL3 最高、EL0 最低。与 claim 完全一致。

supporting_quotes.exact: 31 general-purpose registers, R0 to R30. Each can be accessed as:
A 64-bit general-purpose register named X0 to X30.
A 32-bit general-purpose register named W0 to W30.

claims.rationale: 引文1 [0,40) '31 general-purpose registers, R0 to R30.' 陈述 31 个通用寄存器 R0-R30，[41,65) 'Each can be accessed as:' 引出多种访问形式；引文2 [0,50) 陈述 64 位形式为 X0-X30；引文3 [0,50) 陈述 32 位形式为 W0-W30。三条引文（同一 source）相互衔接、无矛盾，共同完整支撑 claim。

supporting_quotes.exact: moves over to a 4-instruction/cycle decode path rising to eight 16-bit instructions, up from three with the A75

claims.rationale: 引文 [16,47) '4-instruction/cycle decode path' 陈述 A76 每周期解码 4 条指令；引文 [85,111) 'up from three with the A75' 陈述 A75 为 3 条。[48,84) 的 'rising to eight 16-bit instructions' 描述宏解码吞吐细节，与 claim 不冲突。解码宽度 4 对比 3 与 claim 一致。

supporting_quotes.exact: the same 64KB, 4-way set associative L1 cache and 256-512KB private L2

observations.subject: Cortex-A76
observations.object: 64KB 4-way set associative L1 cache and 256-512KB private L2

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,70) 'the same 64KB, 4-way set associative L1 cache and 256-512KB private L2' 直接陈述沿用（the same，即保持不变）64KB 4 路组相联 L1 cache 与 256-512KB 私有 L2。claim 两个要素（L1 规格与相联度、L2 容量与私有性）均被直接覆盖，无冲突。

supporting_quotes.exact: paired up with two SIMD NEON execution pipelines, only one of which can handle floating-point divide and multiply-accumulate instructions. Both of these dual 128-bit

qualifiers.floating_point_divide_and_multiply_accum: only one of the two pipelines

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,138) 'paired up with two SIMD NEON execution pipelines, only one of which can handle floating-point divide and multiply-accumulate instructions.' 直接陈述两条 SIMD NEON 流水线且仅其一可处理浮点除法与乘加。[139,165) 'Both of these dual 128-bit' 为下文截断片段，超出 claim 范围且不构成冲突。与 claim 一致。

supporting_quotes.exact: In the Arm memory model, the Shareability memory attribute indicates the degree to which hardware must ensure memory coherency between a set of observers. See Memory types and attributes.

observations.subject: Arm memory model
observations.object: degree to which hardware must ensure memory coherency between a set of observers

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,154) 'In the Arm memory model, the Shareability memory attribute indicates the degree to which hardware must ensure memory coherency between a set of observers.' 直接陈述 Shareability 属性表示硬件须在一组观察者之间保证内存一致性的程度，与 claim 的措辞逐点对应（'多个观察者'对应 'a set of observers'，语义等价）。[155,187) 'See Memory types and attributes.' 仅为交叉引用，不影响判定。

supporting_quotes.exact: The implementation of a memory system depends heavily on the microarchitecture and therefore many details of the memory system are IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED. The Arm architecture defines the application level interface to the memory system, including a hierarchical memory system with multiple levels of cache

observations.subject: Arm architecture
observations.object: application level interface to the memory system, including a hierarchical memory system with multiple levels of cache

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,154) '...many details of the memory system are IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED.' 陈述存储系统许多细节为 IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED；引文 [155,306) 'The Arm architecture defines the application level interface to the memory system, including a hierarchical memory system with multiple levels of cache' 陈述架构定义应用层可见的含多级 cache 的分层存储系统。claim 两个要素均被直接支撑，无冲突。
